title: An array one element past maxArraySize loses the extra element silently
rationale: Truncation here is by design, but the mechanism deserves pinning: elements beyond the limit are dropped with no exception, no marker, and - unlike maxMapSize, which logs at WARN - only a log.debug. The bound is correct; the silence is what a reader needs to see stated.
catchesBugClass: A change in truncation policy at the array bound, and any regression where truncation additionally corrupts the surviving elements or the inferred type.
cannotCatch: It cannot detect that truncation OCCURRED from the output alone. It also cannot catch the far more serious lower-bound behaviour, because truncating to 2 keeps the value above the size>1 detection gate.

predicted.detail: Discarding elements past a configured array bound is precisely what the bound is for, and critically the TYPE survives - the field is still a list of the right element shape.
